metadata.coverage_note: Published 302,000 km² coastal domain from northern Vancouver Island to Punta Eugenia and the 2,000 m isobath. Approximate A 8–13%, B 60–90% are judgment ranges, not measured fractions; exact bathymetry unavailable. All 349 labels reviewed; 100% of reference 2019 landings assigned, with 37.3786% at Very low confidence. All three WARN diagnostics retained.
